patch_description:
This edit combines two improvements:
1. Add CCRZ (controlled-controlled-RZ) gates to capture richer three-qubit correlations, similar to the successful program 2 which achieved validation_accuracy=0.64
2. Rewire the CZ gate from [6,7] to [4,7] to improve entanglement topology by creating a bridge from the lower-middle region (qubit 4) to the upper region (qubit 7), as recommended

These changes should improve validation accuracy and reduce the generalization gap while keeping parameter count reasonable.
